rationale: OSIS is an Indonesian intraschool student organization, broadly comparable to a school student council. Majlis Perwakilan Pelajar is primarily Malaysia’s university-level Student Representative Council, so the two answers are not interchangeable across the full scope of “student council.” This is an institutional-level contrast, not a false-friend contrast.
